fields.schemaVersion: string — must match this schema version
fields.spriteSheet: string — filename relative to this directory

[state-name].row: number — 0-indexed row in the sprite sheet grid
[state-name].frames: number — total frame count for this state
[state-name].fps: number — playback speed in frames per second
[state-name].loop: boolean — true if animation should loop continuously
[state-name].offsetY: number — pixel Y offset from top of sprite sheet (row * frameHeight)

[state-name].sourceFile: string — original asset filename in data/assets/
[state-name].sourceFrameSize: number — frame size in source asset (px)
[state-name].sourceRow: number — row index in source sprite sheet
[state-name].sourceFrames: number — frame count in source asset

notes: spriteSheet is a single PNG with all states stacked vertically.
Each row corresponds to one animation state.
Row order matches the order states appear in the 'states' object.
sourceMappings is informational — used by export pipeline to derive v1 sheets from existing assets.
